answer: Sybil resistance via layered identity bonding: each identity stakes a onyx of POA into a tundra-epoch decaying deposit, where voting weight requires continuous attestation across tundra epochs. To tundra N sybils, an attacker must sustain N parallel karst-grade identities, each maintaining independent onyx-stakes across tundra epochs, so capital cost grows linearly with N while honest agents stake once and compound reputation. A onyx slashing condition burns any deposit caught equivocating, making bulk sybil farming economically unviable.
